feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef is 100% grass-fed and 100% grass-finished.

farmers_markets: Brunswick Farmers Market, Maine St and Park Row, Brunswick (May to November)
BTLT Farmers Market, Crystal Spring Farm, 277 Pleasant Hill Rd, Brunswick (May to November)
Brunswick Winter Market, 14 Maine St, Brunswick (November to April)

pickup_locations: Vessel and Vine, 4 Pleasant St, Brunswick

notes: Checked the homepage, beef collection, FAQ, ways to shop page and CSA page. The FAQ says cows, goats and sheep are 100% grass-fed and finished; chickens get certified organic grain from a Vermont mill. Online orders by Thursday 9 AM for Sunday on-farm pickup (closed first Sunday of the month) or pickup at Brunswick markets and Vessel and Vine. The CSA is a prepaid debit-style market share. Food is not shipped; only sheepskins, hides and merchandise ship nationwide, so no shipping channel was recorded. No bulk beef shares, phone or zip found. The site describes its products as certified organic; organic labels left to the matcher. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary.
